open_fastservo_v2.header: open_fastservo_v2 (was open_strategy_actmodel_v2) = open_fastservo_v1 with turn_front_latency 0.5 (less inner contact) and finish_distance 0.6 (0.7 overshot the start section in CW). For the sim_actuator_model servo.

open_fastservo_v4.header: open_fastservo_v4 = open_fastservo_v2 + turn_front_heading_axis: true (front wall measured along the track heading, not the car heading; extra-turn fix found in honest runs).

open_strategy_race_entry_v6.header: Experimental v6: front entry advanced 5 cm; validation pending. Observer uses simulation clock and unchanged actuator acceleration2.

obstacle_planner_v8.header: planner_v8 = planner_v5 + speed cap 0.50 m/s on straights, 0.35 m/s^2 lateral (about 0.33 m/s in tight turns). No parking.
